أ- ازالة الاعلانات

Want to get accurate temperature index at a glance? This digital thermometer can turn your phone into a real-time temperature checker with ambient temperature and feels like.

==Features==

—— Real-time temperature information. Automatically shows the temperature of your    location.

—— Automatically displays temperature and feels like of your current location

—— Supports Fahrenheit and Celsius selection

—— Realistic design style, simple and elegant interface

—— Super cool thermometer styles for you to choose

-An ambient temperature thermometer for cities worldwide: this live thermometer app is not only a weather detector for your own location, but also a global weather tracker that you can search world weather and temperature. You can check weather globally like Los Angeles, New York, Chicago, Las Vegas, Hawaii, Sydney, Perth, Amsterdam, Tokyo, Ottawa, Toronto, etc.


If you would like to help us localize the app, please contact us: support@amberweather.com
